purpose: Thirteenth independent U3 reserve, frozen after twelfth-reserve development repairs and before first production export or on-device generation.
evaluationOrder: Inspect first-run production readiness and every frozen semantic obligation before modifying implementation. Preserve raw generation and replay even if the quality gate fails.

semanticCriteria.acceptable: Every contentful request yields a sendable draft with the intended addressee, all status and time relations, uncertainty, conditions, negation, numerical units, exact literals, and recipient restrictions intact. The two source-free modifiers are rejected before review.
semanticCriteria.critical: A copied writer command, missing addressee, changed status or date relation, lost uncertainty or condition, changed number or unit, altered literal, invented outcome, or source-free bare literal marked ready.
semanticCriteria.minor: Equivalent grammar and tone changes that preserve all required meaning.
semanticCriteria.gate: All 14 contentful cases READY with zero critical meaning and exact-literal errors, and both source-free cases REJECTED before review.
